dataset.name: CLEVR
dataset.description: Compositional visual-question-answering benchmark. This catalogue entry is the pinned maujim/CLEVR_sample_500 validation population: 1,070 questions over 107 distinct original CLEVR images. Its public preview shows 100 questions on 100 distinct images; the separate clevr-v1-full entry indexes all 999,968 official train/validation/test questions.
